title: Unix Timestamp Converter
h1: Unix Timestamp Converter — Seconds to Date and Back
seoTitle: Unix Timestamp Converter — Free Online Epoch Converter
description: Convert Unix timestamps (seconds or milliseconds) to human-readable dates and convert dates back to timestamps. Works in your browser with no uploads.
intro: Enter a Unix timestamp or a date and convert between them. Supports both seconds and milliseconds. All calculations happen locally on your device.
blurb: Convert between Unix timestamps and readable dates — free and private.
howItWorks: Enter a numeric timestamp or a date string.
Choose seconds or milliseconds and click the conversion button.
The result appears immediately. Use Now to fill the current timestamp.
examples: Convert 1735689600 to see the corresponding UTC date.
Turn a date like 2025-06-15 into a Unix timestamp for an API.
Check whether a timestamp is in seconds or milliseconds by the magnitude.

faq.a: It is the number of seconds (or milliseconds) that have elapsed since 1 January 1970 00:00:00 UTC.
The converter works in UTC for numeric timestamps and uses the browser's local interpretation for date strings.
